items.title: Henry "Jack" Palmer Interview
items.q: I was with June Clark, see. And I always had my own outfit.

ctx.x: That was you, my man's done. Yeah. Well, yeah. That's fine. Well, you can remember recording with the folks in New York and my man's done done me dirty. That's right. That's right. That's right.

Then it must be that session. Yeah, that's what that's... She didn't have but two. She did two on that set. See, and the other girls did other two. Yeah. We didn't do but two. I cannot already. And I never did finish rest of them because when they formed the other band, I was with June Clark, see. And I always had my own outfit.
Yeah. Can you remember who was with you on that particular session? I think, yes.
